newsitem.title: POLAND: Bank Komunalny postpones bond issue.
newsitem.headline: Bank Komunalny postpones bond issue.

text.p: Polish Securities Commission (KPW) has suspended procedures of approving Polish Bank Komunalny SA convertible bond for public trade, after the bank requested it to do so, Komunalny said in a statement.
Komunalny said in a Tuesday statement it asked the KPW to suspend the procedures to be able to call a shareholders meeting to make some amendments in its earlier bond motion.
Earlier Komunalny said it planned to issue two million 30-month convertible bonds worth about 50 million in May this year.
